General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Complete Door & Glass Seal & Gasket Kit
Eliminates Door & Glass Noise
Makes Glass Easier to Roll Up & Down because of the New Felt.
Makes Doors Feel More “Solid” When Closing
Eliminates Water Entering the Inside of Vehicle.
EASY & SIMPLE TO INSTALL
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Inner Glass Scrape Weather Strip
Qty 2 – Outer Glass Scrape Weather Strip
Qty 2 – Glass Felt Weather Strip (fits inside glass channel)
Qty 1 – Door Rubber Seal, RH
Qty 1 – Door Rubber Seal, LH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
